Platform.Operating system: Windows Phone 8.1 Update 2 (Lumia Denim) upgradable to Windows 10 Mobile

Display.Display: 5-inch 720p HD IPS LCD, 294 ppi (Lumia 640), 5.7-inch 720p IPS LCD, 258 ppi (Lumia 640 XL), Corning Gorilla Glass 3

Cameras.Rear camera: 8.0 MP auto-focus, f/2.2 with LED flash, FHD 1920x1080 video (Lumia 640), 13.0 MP, BSI, auto-focus, 10 cm minimum focus range, f/2.0, 28 mm focal length with LED flash, FHD 1920x1080 video (Lumia 640 XL Only)
Cameras.Front camera: 0.9 MP, 720p video (Lumia 640), 5.0 MP, 1080p video (Lumia 640 XL Only)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0 (LE), Assisted GPS, GPS/GLONASS/BeiDou, Micro-USB 2.0, Wi-Fi: 802.11b/g/n, WiFi Hotspot, WPS, FM radio
